wholePhysicalScope: The present exterior and open court follow the outer and inner member ways of OSM relation 1354798. Three mapped gates fix the entrance positions.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the irregular limestone perimeter, canal-facing arches and guard turret, portal approaches and the open curved courtyard.
limitations: Wall heights, blind-side fenestration, current stone finish and individual terrace levels are approximated.
The model includes the exterior, open inner courtyard and recessed entrances. It omits adjacent landing-stage structures and interiors behind the masonry.
